title: Recursive preorder traversal
summary: Follow a preorder traversal of a 7-node binary tree. Visiting a node adds it to the output. Returning from a call does not.
context: The binary tree has 7 nodes. Root 1 has children 2 and 3. Node 2 has children 4 and 5, and node 3 has children 6 and 7, listed left to right. Nodes 4, 5, 6, and 7 are leaves.

Preorder visits the root, then the left subtree, then the right subtree. On entering a nonempty node, record its value immediately and recurse into its left and right children in order. A call on an empty subtree returns immediately.
description: The call path lists active calls from the root to the current node. The 11 steps omit calls on empty subtrees. In 7 steps a node is visited for the first time, and in 4 steps calls return. Steps 4 and 9 return from a left leaf to its parent before entering the right subtree. Steps 6 and 11 return up two levels.

frames.title: Visit root 1
frames.explanation: Start at root 1 and record 1. Call path: 1. Output: [1]. Neither the left subtree (2, 4, 5) nor the right subtree (3, 6, 7) has been visited. Next visit the left child, 2.

frames.title: Visit left child 2
frames.explanation: From 1, visit its left child 2 and record 2. Call path: 1 → 2. Output: [1, 2]. The two leaves under 2 (4 and 5) and the root's right subtree (3, 6, 7) have yet to be visited. Next visit 4.

frames.title: Visit leaf 4
frames.explanation: From 2, visit left leaf 4 and record 4. Call path: 1 → 2 → 4. Output: [1, 2, 4]. The calls on both empty subtrees of 4 return immediately, then control will return to 2. Node 5 and the root's right subtree (3, 6, 7) are still unvisited.

frames.title: Return from 4 to 2
frames.explanation: Leaf 4 is finished. Return to parent 2; the call path is now 1 → 2. Returning records no new node, so the output stays [1, 2, 4]. The left subtree of 2 is complete. Next visit its right child, 5. The root's right subtree (3, 6, 7) is still unvisited.
frames.key_state: Call path: 1 → 2. Output: [1, 2, 4]. Next visit the right child of 2, node 5.
frames.announcement: Returned from leaf 4 to its parent 2. Output stays [1, 2, 4]. Next visit the right child of 2, node 5.

frames.title: Visit leaf 5
frames.explanation: From 2, visit right leaf 5 and record 5. Call path: 1 → 2 → 5. Output: [1, 2, 4, 5]. Every node in the root's left subtree has been visited, but the calls have yet to return. The calls on the two empty subtrees of 5 return immediately. The root's right subtree (3, 6, 7) is still unvisited.

frames.title: Return from 5 through 2 to 1
frames.explanation: When 5 finishes, return to 2. Both subtrees of 2 are complete, so return again to root 1. The call path is now 1, and the output stays [1, 2, 4, 5]. The root's left subtree is complete. Next enter its unvisited right subtree (3, 6, 7), starting at node 3.
frames.key_state: Call path: 1. Output: [1, 2, 4, 5]. Next visit 3, the right child of root 1.
frames.announcement: Returned from leaf 5 through 2 to root 1. Output stays [1, 2, 4, 5]. Next visit 3, the right child of root 1.

frames.title: Visit right child 3
frames.explanation: From root 1, enter its right child 3 and record 3. Call path: 1 → 3. Output: [1, 2, 4, 5, 3]. The left and right leaves of 3, nodes 6 and 7, are still unvisited. Next visit 6.

frames.title: Visit leaf 6
frames.explanation: From 3, visit left leaf 6 and record 6. Call path: 1 → 3 → 6. Output: [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6]. Calls on the two empty subtrees of 6 return immediately, then control will return to 3. Only the right leaf, 7, remains unvisited.

frames.title: Return from 6 to 3
frames.explanation: Leaf 6 is finished. Return to parent 3. The call path is now 1 → 3, and the output stays [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6]. The left subtree of 3 is complete. Next visit its remaining right leaf, 7.
frames.key_state: Call path: 1 → 3. Output: [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6]. Next visit the right child of 3, node 7.
frames.announcement: Returned from leaf 6 to its parent 3. Output stays [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6]. Next visit the right child of 3, node 7.

frames.title: Visit leaf 7
frames.explanation: From 3, visit right leaf 7 and record 7. Call path: 1 → 3 → 7. The output is complete: [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7]. The calls for 7, 3, and 1 still need to return.
frames.key_state: Call path: 1 → 3 → 7. Output: [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7]. All values have been recorded, but the calls have yet to return.
frames.announcement: Visited the last leaf, 7. The output is complete: [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7]. The calls have yet to return.

frames.title: Return from 7 through 3 to 1 and finish
frames.explanation: After the calls on the empty left and right subtrees of 7 finish, return along 7 → 3 → 1. The call on the root then ends. Every subtree is complete, the call path is empty, and the final output remains [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7].
frames.key_state: Call path: empty. Output: [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7]. All calls have returned.
frames.announcement: The final calls return in order: 7, 3, 1. The recursion is complete, and the output stays [1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7].
